chunks: From him, from Ḥusayn ibn Hāshim, from Ibn Muskān, from al-Ḥalabī, from Abī ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام, who said:
"The Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله would perform the zuhr salat at a dhirāʿ, and the ʿasr salat at approximately that likewise."

If it is said: the reports which indicate that the beginning of the time is more virtuous are general, and there is no specification in them of the time that you mentioned, then from where did you say that, and why did you not carry them upon generality?
It is said to him: We carried that upon what we have said so that the reports do not contradict one another, and there have also come transmitted reports explaining them.

key_terms.أَفْضَلُ: more virtuous or superior in merit
key_terms.أَوَّلَ الْوَقْتِ: the beginning part of the prescribed prayer time
key_terms.تَتَنَاقَضَ: to be contradictory or mutually conflicting
key_terms.تَخْصِيصُ: specification or restriction of a general wording

ai.seo_question: How are general narrations about the virtue of the earliest prayer time reconciled with specific reports on the timing of zuhr and ʿasr salat?
ai.summary: This report states that the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله performed the zuhr and ʿasr salat at specified portions of the prayer time. It also addresses how general narrations about the virtue of praying at the earliest time are interpreted in light of more detailed reports, so that the hadiths are reconciled rather than treated as contradictory.
